name: Yattekita Onna Joushi
source:
You thought you were fated to be a loser at the bottom rungs of society for the rest of your life.
However, unexpectedly you land yourself a good job, and a pretty girlfriend Momoko.

You look forward to living a newfound peaceful and happy life, but then...
you suddenly get a new female boss Miyana who smashes your tranquil life into pieces.

A certain happening with your strong female boss brings to light a secret that your girlfriend was hiding.

Of course, she's not the only one with a secret. All three of you are hiding something.
In the end, what will happen?

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ01017766.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
你本以为自己注定一辈子都是社会底层的失败者。
然而，出乎意料的是，你找到了一份好工作，还有一位漂亮的女友Momoko。

你期待从此过上安稳幸福的生活，然而……
新来的女上司Miyana突然出现，将这份平静彻底打碎。

与这位强势女上司之间发生的一件事，揭开了女友隐藏的秘密。

当然，有秘密的并非只有她。你们三个人，都有所隐瞒。
最后，事情会如何发展？
